events.name: Mannheim Steamroller Christmas
events.info: The holiday tradition continues! MANNHEIM STEAMROLLER CHRISTMAS (MSC) by Chip Davis has been America's favorite holiday tradition for over 40 years! Grammy Award winner Chip Davis has created a show that features the MSC classics in the distinctive Mannheim sound. The program includes 15 musicians playing over 20 instruments against a backdrop of dazzling multimedia effects, capturing the spirit of the season in an immersive yet intimate setting.

events.info: Candles? glow plus irresistible music make this concert a midwinter must. Saint-Georges was a virtuoso violinist and a pioneering composer to which his vibrant L?amant Anonyme Overture attests. Mozart?s Divertimento is a crowning achievement from the master and a Sinfonia Concertante by Johann Sebastian Bach?s youngest son features MSO?s own Alexander Ilchev and Mert Özkan. Mozart?s sparkling Symphony No. 29, embodying both his youthful vigor and early maturity, commands the concert?s second half.

events.info: Think of the opening, natural-world charm of Delius? On Hearing the First Cuckoo in Spring as a tasty appetizer for the following full-immersion feast of Bruckner?s Symphony No. 4. events.name: Mississippi Symphony Orchestra: Shining Lights
events.info: An evening of refreshing selections herald the vernal season?s arrival. Respighi?s shimmering Il Trittico Botticelliano evokes a trio of Botticelli masterpieces, including The Birth of Venus. Italian composer Allegro?s radiant October Light, 2025 winner of MSO?s Premier Orchestral Institute International Composition Competition, spreads warmth and positivity. Ries, friend and student of Beethoven, signals the emergence of his own musical voice with the drama and energy of his most popular Symphony No. 6, in a joyous finish that matches the exuberant glory of spring.

boxOfficeInfo.phoneNumberDetail: For most events, you can get tickets over the phone at the ardenland office at 601.487.2562. For any Broadway in Jackson events, please call 601.439.5229. The Thalia Mara Hall office number is 601.960.1535.
boxOfficeInfo.openHoursDetail: Thalia Mara Hall does NOT have a box office in the building. For most events, advance tickets can be purchased in person at the ardenland office - 622 Duling Avenue, STE 212, Jackson, MS 39216. Please call 601.487.2562 in advance of stopping by to make sure we are selling tickets for the event you are interested in! The ardenland office is open from 9AM - 6PM. On the day of the event, the box office opens inside Thalia Mara Hall two (2) hours before the doors open.
boxOfficeInfo.acceptedPaymentDetail: Most shows accept all major debit/credit cards and cash. Broadway in Jackson events do NOT accept cash.
boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: On the day of the event, the box office opens inside Thalia Mara Hall two (2) hours before the doors open. Tickets can be picked up anytime after the box office opens.

venues.parkingDetail: Parking offsite and on the street is free. There is a parking garage directly across from Thalia Mara Hall that requires you to pay at the gate.
venues.accessibleSeatingDetail: Yes, there are accessible seating options at Thalia Mara Hall in Row P and Row MM in the orchestra sections on the floor. You can purchase ADA seating online. If you have any questions - do not hesitate to reach out to the ardenland office at 601.960.1535.

generalInfo.generalRule: Come on in and enjoy the show!
generalInfo.childRule: Children 18 months & older need a ticket to attend.
